title: "Task 3: Differential Isoform Usage (DIU) + FCS"
format: html
---

Library loading
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(DESeq2)
library(DEXSeq)
```


## Step 1: Filter isoforms

Keep isoforms with at least 10 reads in at least as many samples as the smallest group has, and only keep genes with 2 or more isoforms (usage can only change when a gene has more than one isoform).
```{r}
filter_iso <- function(iso, min_samples, min_count = 10) {
  keep <- rowSums(iso >= min_count) >= min_samples
  iso  <- iso[keep, ]
  info <- isoInfo[match(rownames(iso), isoInfo$transcript_id),
                  c("transcript_id", "gene_id", "gene_name")]
  found <- !is.na(info$gene_id)
  iso  <- iso[found, ];  info <- info[found, ]
  multi <- info$gene_id %in% info$gene_id[duplicated(info$gene_id)]
  list(counts = iso[multi, ], info = info[multi, ])
}
```

```{r}
prkn_f  <- filter_iso(iso_prkn,  min_samples = 4)   # 74,905 isoforms, 13,134 genes
lrrk2_f <- filter_iso(iso_lrrk2, min_samples = 9)   # 74,318 isoforms, 13,101 genes
```

## Dataset 1: PRKN (GSE90514)

### Step 2: PCA (quality check)
```{r}
meta_prkn$condition <- factor(meta_prkn$condition, levels = c("Control", "PD"))
all(colnames(prkn_f$counts) == rownames(meta_prkn))   # must be TRUE
```

```{r}
dds_prkn <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = round(as.matrix(prkn_f$counts)),
                                   colData   = meta_prkn,
                                   design    = ~ condition)
rld_prkn <- rlog(dds_prkn)
plotPCA(rld_prkn, intgroup = "condition")
plotPCA(rld_prkn, intgroup = c("condition", "gender"))
```

### Step 3: Differential isoform usage (DEXSeq)

Isoform rows and info rows must be in the same order.
```{r}
all(rownames(prkn_f$counts) == prkn_f$info$transcript_id)   # must be TRUE

sample_prkn <- data.frame(row.names = colnames(prkn_f$counts),
                          condition = meta_prkn$condition)
```

DEXSeq takes a long time, so the result is saved once and then re-loaded. To re-run it, delete the `.rds` file in `results/`.
```{r}
if (file.exists(prkn_file)) {
  dxr_prkn <- readRDS(prkn_file)
} else {
  dxd_prkn <- DEXSeqDataSet(countData  = round(as.matrix(prkn_f$counts)),
                            sampleData = sample_prkn,
                            design     = ~ sample + exon + condition:exon,
                            featureID  = prkn_f$info$transcript_id,   # isoform
                            groupID    = prkn_f$info$gene_id)         # gene

  dxr_prkn <- DEXSeq(dxd_prkn,
                     reducedModel = ~ sample + exon,   # drops condition:exon = usage test
                     BPPARAM = BiocParallel::MulticoreParam(4))
  saveRDS(dxr_prkn, prkn_file)
}
```

How many significant isoforms, and in how many genes?
```{r}
sum(dxr_prkn$padj < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)                                # 289
length(unique(dxr_prkn$groupID[which(dxr_prkn$padj < 0.05)]))          # 253
```

### Step 3b: DEXSeq corrected for gender

Same test as above, but gender is added to both models so that differences between males and females are not mistaken for PD effects (the same correction as in dataset 2).
```{r}
sample_prkn$gender <- factor(meta_prkn$gender)
table(sample_prkn$condition, sample_prkn$gender)   # check the design is balanced
```

```{r}
prkn_g_file <- file.path(results_dir, "03_GSE90514_dexseq_gender.rds")

if (file.exists(prkn_g_file)) {
  dxr_prkn_g <- readRDS(prkn_g_file)
} else {
  dxd_prkn_g <- DEXSeqDataSet(countData  = round(as.matrix(prkn_f$counts)),
                              sampleData = sample_prkn,
                              design     = ~ sample + exon + gender:exon + condition:exon,
                              featureID  = prkn_f$info$transcript_id,   # isoform
                              groupID    = prkn_f$info$gene_id)         # gene

  dxr_prkn_g <- DEXSeq(dxd_prkn_g,
                       reducedModel = ~ sample + exon + gender:exon,   # usage test, corrected for gender
                       BPPARAM = BiocParallel::MulticoreParam(4))
  saveRDS(dxr_prkn_g, prkn_g_file)
}
```

How many significant isoforms and genes with the gender correction, and how many genes are found by both models?
```{r}
sum(dxr_prkn_g$padj < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)
genes_prkn   <- unique(dxr_prkn$groupID[which(dxr_prkn$padj < 0.05)])
genes_prkn_g <- unique(dxr_prkn_g$groupID[which(dxr_prkn_g$padj < 0.05)])
length(genes_prkn_g)
length(intersect(genes_prkn, genes_prkn_g))
```

## Dataset 2: LRRK2 / sporadic PD (GSE167529, 25 mM)

### Step 2: PCA (quality check)
```{r}
meta_lrrk2$condition <- factor(meta_lrrk2$condition, levels = c("Control", "PD"))
meta_lrrk2$batch     <- factor(meta_lrrk2$batch)
all(colnames(lrrk2_f$counts) == rownames(meta_lrrk2))   # must be TRUE
```

```{r}
dds_lrrk2 <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = round(as.matrix(lrrk2_f$counts)),
                                    colData   = meta_lrrk2,
                                    design    = ~ condition)
rld_lrrk2 <- rlog(dds_lrrk2)
plotPCA(rld_lrrk2, intgroup = "condition")
plotPCA(rld_lrrk2, intgroup = c("condition", "gender"))
plotPCA(rld_lrrk2, intgroup = c("condition", "batch"))   # PC1 (66%) splits by batch -> correct for batch
```

### Step 3: Differential isoform usage (DEXSeq), corrected for batch + gender
```{r}
all(rownames(lrrk2_f$counts) == lrrk2_f$info$transcript_id)   # must be TRUE

sample_lrrk2 <- data.frame(row.names = colnames(lrrk2_f$counts),
                           condition = meta_lrrk2$condition,
                           gender    = meta_lrrk2$gender,
                           batch     = meta_lrrk2$batch)
```

```{r}
if (file.exists(lrrk2_file)) {
  dxr_lrrk2 <- readRDS(lrrk2_file)
} else {
  dxd_lrrk2 <- DEXSeqDataSet(countData  = round(as.matrix(lrrk2_f$counts)),
                             sampleData = sample_lrrk2,
                             design     = ~ sample + exon + batch:exon + gender:exon + condition:exon,
                             featureID  = lrrk2_f$info$transcript_id,   # isoform
                             groupID    = lrrk2_f$info$gene_id)         # gene

  dxr_lrrk2 <- DEXSeq(dxd_lrrk2,
                      reducedModel = ~ sample + exon + batch:exon + gender:exon,   # usage test, corrected for batch + gender
                      BPPARAM = BiocParallel::MulticoreParam(4))
  saveRDS(dxr_lrrk2, lrrk2_file)
}
```

```{r}
sum(dxr_lrrk2$padj < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)                               # 1,396
length(unique(dxr_lrrk2$groupID[which(dxr_lrrk2$padj < 0.05)]))        # 1,140
```



## Step 4: Collapse isoforms to gene level (Week 6)

For each gene, keep only the isoform with the smallest p-value, then re-adjust the p-values across genes. The PRKN model corrected for gender is used.
```{r}
library(fgsea)
library(msigdbr)
alpha <- 0.05

collapse_to_gene <- function(dxr) {
  dxr %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    as_tibble() %>%
    filter(!is.na(stat)) %>%
    dplyr::select(gene_id = groupID, isoform_id = featureID, stat,
                  log2FC = starts_with("log2fold"), pvalue, padj) %>%
    group_by(gene_id) %>%
    slice_min(order_by = pvalue, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(padj = p.adjust(pvalue, method = "fdr"),
           gene_id = sub("\\.\\d+$", "", gene_id))
}

dex_gene_prkn  <- collapse_to_gene(dxr_prkn_g)
dex_gene_lrrk2 <- collapse_to_gene(dxr_lrrk2)

sum(dex_gene_prkn$padj  < alpha)   # significant DIU genes, PRKN
sum(dex_gene_lrrk2$padj < alpha)   # significant DIU genes, LRRK2

write.csv(dex_gene_prkn,  file.path(results_dir, "03_GSE90514_diu_gene_level.csv"),  row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(dex_gene_lrrk2, file.path(results_dir, "03_GSE167529_diu_gene_level.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

## Step 5: Compare DIU with DGE at gene level (Week 6)

DGE results from task 2. Fisher's exact test checks whether more genes are significant in both analyses than expected by chance. Only genes tested in both analyses are used.
```{r}
deseq_prkn  <- read.csv(file.path(results_dir, "04_GSE90514_dge_adjusted.csv"))
deseq_lrrk2 <- read.csv(file.path(results_dir, "04_GSE167529_dge_adjusted.csv"))

compare_dex_deseq <- function(dex_gene, deseq_gene) {
  inner_join(dex_gene   %>% transmute(gene_id, DEXSeq = !is.na(padj) & padj < alpha),
             deseq_gene %>% transmute(gene_id, DESeq2 = !is.na(padj) & padj < alpha),
             by = "gene_id") %>%
    with(table(DEXSeq, DESeq2))
}
```

```{r}
contig_prkn <- compare_dex_deseq(dex_gene_prkn, deseq_prkn)
contig_prkn
fisher.test(contig_prkn, alternative = "greater")
```

```{r}
contig_lrrk2 <- compare_dex_deseq(dex_gene_lrrk2, deseq_lrrk2)
contig_lrrk2
fisher.test(contig_lrrk2, alternative = "greater")
```

## Step 6: FCS and comparison with DGE at gene-set level (Week 6)

GO:BP gene sets; genes ranked by the DEXSeq stat value.
```{r}
BP_df   <- msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens", category = "C5", subcategory = "GO:BP")
BP_list <- split(BP_df$ensembl_gene, BP_df$gs_name)

make_ranks <- function(df) {
  stats <- setNames(df$stat, df$gene_id)
  stats <- stats[!is.na(stats)]
  sort(stats, decreasing = TRUE)
}
```

```{r}
set.seed(42)
fg_dex_prkn    <- fgseaMultilevel(pathways = BP_list, stats = make_ranks(dex_gene_prkn),
                                  minSize = 15, maxSize = 500, scoreType = "std")
fg_deseq_prkn  <- fgseaMultilevel(pathways = BP_list, stats = make_ranks(deseq_prkn),
                                  minSize = 15, maxSize = 500, scoreType = "std")
fg_dex_lrrk2   <- fgseaMultilevel(pathways = BP_list, stats = make_ranks(dex_gene_lrrk2),
                                  minSize = 15, maxSize = 500, scoreType = "std")
fg_deseq_lrrk2 <- fgseaMultilevel(pathways = BP_list, stats = make_ranks(deseq_lrrk2),
                                  minSize = 15, maxSize = 500, scoreType = "std")

sum(fg_dex_prkn$padj  < alpha, na.rm = TRUE)   # significant gene sets, DIU PRKN
sum(fg_dex_lrrk2$padj < alpha, na.rm = TRUE)   # significant gene sets, DIU LRRK2
```

How many gene sets are significant in DIU, DGE or both, and how well do the NES values agree?
```{r}
compare_sets <- function(fg_deseq, fg_dex) {
  inner_join(fg_deseq %>% transmute(pathway, NES_de = NES, padj_de = padj),
             fg_dex   %>% transmute(pathway, NES_dx = NES, padj_dx = padj),
             by = "pathway") %>%
    mutate(sig_cat = case_when(
      padj_de < alpha & padj_dx < alpha  ~ "Both",
      padj_de < alpha & padj_dx >= alpha ~ "DESeq2 only",
      padj_de >= alpha & padj_dx < alpha ~ "DEXSeq only",
      TRUE ~ "None"),
      sig_cat = factor(sig_cat, levels = c("Both", "DESeq2 only", "DEXSeq only", "None")))
}

cmp_prkn  <- compare_sets(fg_deseq_prkn,  fg_dex_prkn)
cmp_lrrk2 <- compare_sets(fg_deseq_lrrk2, fg_dex_lrrk2)

table(cmp_prkn$sig_cat)
table(cmp_lrrk2$sig_cat)

cor(cmp_prkn$NES_de,  cmp_prkn$NES_dx,  method = "spearman", use = "complete.obs")
cor(cmp_lrrk2$NES_de, cmp_lrrk2$NES_dx, method = "spearman", use = "complete.obs")
```

```{r}
plot_nes <- function(cmp, title_txt) {
  ggplot(cmp, aes(x = NES_de, y = NES_dx, color = sig_cat)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.8) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE) +
    labs(x = "NES (DESeq2 fgsea)", y = "NES (DEXSeq fgsea)", color = "Significance",
         title = title_txt) +
    theme_minimal()
}

p_nes_prkn  <- plot_nes(cmp_prkn,  "PRKN (GSE90514): NES DGE vs DIU")
p_nes_lrrk2 <- plot_nes(cmp_lrrk2, "LRRK2/sporadic (GSE167529): NES DGE vs DIU")
p_nes_prkn
p_nes_lrrk2
```

Save the gene-set results and plots.
```{r}
save_fg <- function(fg, file) {
  fg <- as.data.frame(fg)
  fg$leadingEdge <- sapply(fg$leadingEdge, paste, collapse = ";")
  write.csv(fg, file.path(results_dir, file), row.names = FALSE)
}
save_fg(fg_dex_prkn,  "03_GSE90514_diu_fcs_go_bp.csv")
save_fg(fg_dex_lrrk2, "03_GSE167529_diu_fcs_go_bp.csv")

pdf(file.path(results_dir, "03_diu_vs_dge_nes_plots.pdf"), width = 8, height = 6)
print(p_nes_prkn)
print(p_nes_lrrk2)
dev.off()
```
